title: Condition-relation classifier reads 'be magically charmed by the aboleth' as mention, not applies
description: creature:aboleth Enslave prints 'must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed by the aboleth'; the emitted mechanics.conditions relation is 'mention' where 'applies' is the printed meaning. The applies grammar in packages/core/src/rules/conditionRelations.ts does not allow an adverb between 'be' and the condition. Not caused by 19.3.5.1 (discovered while source-checking its aboleth regression); re-derive and fix under docs/importer-fix-protocol.md, then check other 'be <adverb> <condition>' phrasings across the pack.
